name: calc_future_value
description:
Future value of a single present amount with annual compounding: FV = PV(1 + r)^t. Computed locally in Python; no API key or network.
Returns {present_value, rate, years, future_value}, future_value rounded to 2 decimals.
Inputs (* required): present_value* (amount), rate* (annual rate in percent), years* (may be fractional).
For monthly or other compounding use calc_compound_interest; the inverse is calc_present_value.
Example: {"present_value": 10000, "rate": 7, "years": 15}
